title: Multiyear Impact of Backorder Delays: A Quasi-Experimental Approach
authors: Hyung Sup Bhan; Eric T. Anderson
eligible_reason: Quasi-experiments around item stock-outs: customers who ordered the same item just before (normal) versus just after (backorder) a stock-out are compared on future purchases, with quasi-experiment (QE) fixed effects. Cross-sectional comparison within QE, mostly fixed-effects Poisson (xtpois) with controls; no unit panel with staggered binary adoption and calendar-time FE. Shipped data are a random subset with noise added and confidential covariates rescaled.
design_notes: replication_code_noise: xtset QE; xtpois fy1ord backorder $controls, fe vce(robust); xtreg fy1purchase/fy1logspending backorder $controls, fe vce(clus QE); interactions with delivery-day terciles/splines.
data_files_note: README 'Masking the data due to NDA/confidentiality': random subset of data, random noise added to all variables, confidential covariates rescaled.
data_provenance_note: Random subset plus random noise on all variables and rescaled covariates.
